subject: TerraScope SE deep-dive + procurement timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@terrascope.ai>, procurement@terrascope.ai
Cc: diego.fernandez@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + SE deep-dive — aligning demo ops & procurement timeline

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the time yesterday. I wanted to loop Diego (SE) and Priyom (Solutions Eng) in so we can lock a two-part plan: 1) brief procurement sync to align on legal/PO/timeline, and 2) SE technical deep-dive with your engineering team.

High-level ask: can you confirm which people from TerraScope should join each session (procurement, security, infra, platform eng)? Also share any constraints (allowed vendors list, docs we should send in advance).

Proposed cadence (PT):
- Procurement sync: 30 minutes — Tue Aug 27 or Wed Aug 28 (morning)
- SE deep-dive: 60 minutes — Wed Sep 1 or Thu Sep 2 (late morning)

Diego / Priyom — are you available for the windows above? If not, propose alternate slots and we can surface to the customer. I’ve attached a short mutual action plan draft and a placeholder calendar file; will replace once we lock times.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: TerraScope-MutualActionPlan.docx (draft)

To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@terrascope.ai
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + SE deep-dive — aligning demo ops & procurement timeline

Hi Marissa — thanks, this looks good.

Attendees:
- Procurement: procurement@terrascope.ai (we'll loop Carlos Ruiz for commercial)
- Security: me (Samantha Li) and Tian Wu (security lead, tian.wu@terrascope.ai)
- Engineering: two platform engineers (names coming shortly)

Availability: we prefer Sep 1 or Sep 2 for the technical session. For procurement sync, Aug 27 morning works better for us (PST).

Before the procurement sync, can you share an overview of data handling (locations, retention), and any accreditation docs (SOC 2 is ideal)? If you can attach a short SOC2 summary that would help speed internal approvals.

Samantha
Head of IT & Security | TerraScope AI
samantha.li@terrascope.ai
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai, ava.chen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + SE deep-dive — aligning demo ops & procurement timeline

Thanks Samantha — great to meet you virtually. Quick notes from the SE side:
- Scope for the 60m deep-dive: architecture (model variants + quantization), latency/cost expectations for your expected QPS, network connectivity & VPC options, and demo of a 2-step inference flow with prefix caching.
- We’ll want 2 engineers from TerraScope on the call so we can do a short live test (if network allowlist is ready).

I attached a one-page SOC2 summary and a short operations runbook that answers retention and network questions. If there are specific endpoints or a staging IP range we should know about, please share so we can pre-authorize.

My availability (PT):
- Aug 27: 09:00–11:30
- Aug 28: 13:00–16:00
- Sep 1: 09:30–12:30
- Sep 2: 10:00–12:00

If Sep 1 at 10:00 PT works for your engineering team I can block it and prepare a short demo plan.

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai

Attachments: SOC2_Audit_Summary.pdf, SE-ops-runbook.md

Hi Marissa / Diego — this is Clara on procurement (procurement@terrascope.ai). A couple of constraints from our side:
- We need a 30-minute procurement-only window before a technical deep-dive to confirm contracting path (PO vs. contract), billing entity, and any specific SLAs required.
- Please provide an outline of key commercial terms (preferred term lengths, renewal cadence, and any early termination clauses). A redlined MSA template is helpful but not required for this initial sync.
- On data handling: we require a retention table (what's retained, how long, and legal basis).

If you can share a 1–page commercial summary and the SOC2 one-pager ahead of the procurement sync that would be great. We can then either join the technical call or do the procurement-only call first.

Clara 
Procurement | TerraScope AI
procurement@terrascope.ai

1) Procurement sync (30m): Fri Aug 27, 09:30 PT — quick commercial checklist + PO path (Marissa + Clara + Carlos)
2) SE deep-dive (60m): Wed Sep 1, 10:00 PT — Diego + Priyom + Ava will lead the demo; Samantha + Tian + two engs from TerraScope

I’ve attached: SOC2_Audit_Summary.pdf (from Diego), a draft mutual action plan, and a calendar invite placeholder for Sep 1 (will send final when times are confirmed).

If procurement prefers a different time on Aug 27, let me know and we’ll adjust. Otherwise I’ll send calendar invites and a short demo agenda by EOD.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the sessions.

Best,
Marissa Cole
